compiled_state.title: GREEN: Update huge-diff agent files — remove REVIEW_RESULT/MIN_SCORE/scores (hand-maintained)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: No reviewer agent definition file contains references to REVIEW_RESULT, MIN_SCORE, or a scores object in its output contract

## Files to modify DIRECTLY (not generated by build-review-agents.sh)
- plugins/dso/agents/huge-diff-reviewer-light.md
- plugins/dso/agents/huge-diff-reviewer-standard.md
- plugins/dso/agents/huge-diff-refactor-anomaly.md

## Changes required (same as reviewer-base.md update in T3)
For each file:
1. Change output contract from 5-line to 3-line format:
   REMOVE: REVIEW_RESULT: {passed|failed}
   REMOVE: MIN_SCORE={lowest numeric score, or 'N/A' if all N/A}
   KEEP: REVIEWER_HASH={sha256}
   KEEP: FINDING_COUNT={N}
   KEEP: FILES: {list}

2. Remove pass/fail rule based on scores:
   REMOVE: '**Pass/fail rule**: REVIEW_RESULT is passed only when every numeric score is 4 or 5...'
   REMOVE: score threshold language (3 or lower fails)

3. Update JSON schema from 3-key to 2-key:
   REMOVE: 'REQUIRED: EXACTLY three top-level keys: scores, findings, summary'
   REMOVE: The 'scores' object with 5 dimensions
   ADD: 'REQUIRED: EXACTLY two top-level keys: findings and summary'

4. Remove REVIEW_RESULT: error references — replace with just returning REVIEWER_HASH on error or stopping

5. Add the pre-output category checklist (same as reviewer-base.md update in T3)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No huge-diff agent contains REVIEW_RESULT
  Verify: ! grep -rq 'REVIEW_RESULT' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/agents/huge-diff-*.md
- [ ] No huge-diff agent contains MIN_SCORE
  Verify: ! grep -rq 'MIN_SCORE' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/agents/huge-diff-*.md
- [ ] No huge-diff agent contains scores object definition
  Verify: ! grep -rq '"scores"' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/agents/huge-diff-*.md
- [ ] All huge-diff agents contain REVIEWER_HASH in their output contract
  Verify: grep -rq 'REVIEWER_HASH' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/agents/huge-diff-*.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
